reviews.title: Used to love
reviews.text: This app was so good, it allowed you to connect multiple platforms to pull memories from and was a great look back at what you were doing. The trivia was cute, and the cartoons of Abe marking your days were great. Now…it routinely disconnects and forces new logins to all platforms, and it takes forever for pictures to load. I’ve got over 9 years with Timehop and I’m ready to just delete the app. It’s become a hassle and waste of time waiting for pictures that take longer to load than it would for me to find them in my very over populated photo album

reviews.title: Too many ads that slow down the app
reviews.text:
This app used to be good before they bloated it with ads. I’ve been using this app for over 10 years and my streak is over 3500 days. So when I say that this might be my last year, it’s bittersweet. But there are too many ads and tapping through them slows down the app to the point I usually have to restart it twice to get through to the end. It makes it so I don’t want to even tap through the memories, I just want to get through the ads. I know there’s premium but I’m not paying $40 a year for MY memories. Maybe $20. But not $40. 

It’ll be hard to let my streak go but maybe it’s time.

reviews.title: Bugs
reviews.text: App has become so buggy now and it’s very difficult to use. Photos don’t load so I’m missing out on the “memories”, and very often will skip back 4 or 5 photos and then freeze. I have to restart the app and start going through again, very often doing this 2 or 3 times. I’m only persevering with it as I want to reach my 10 year streak but after that I think I will give up unless it improves dramatically. Shame, because it used to be a highlight of my day, but now seems pretty pointless. I don’t even mind the adverts every 5 pictures, as I get they need to make money in order to maintain the app, but I’m guessing they’ve made the free version so buggy so that I sign up to the premium to see if it improves. However, on current performance there is no way I’d pay money for this.

reviews.title: What happened?

Ever since they added the option for a subscription service everything has went downhill fast. I didn’t mind the ads sprinkled in, I just scrolled through them. Now there are so many ads that won’t let you swipe without playing the entire thing, and then the app freezes and I have to close it and reopen it only for the same thing to happen again! And what happened to the option to crop the photo into a square before sharing? Everything is just awful now since the update. I will not pay to look at my own photos. I used to look forward to my daily timehop, now it’s a chore just so I can keep my streak. Shame.
